Why cheaper

Why are we cheaper?

A website is expensive mostly because of the time spent on it. I have cut that time, not the care. Here is how, and what you keep.

Optimisation

Automated work where things repeat, and direct hosting in France.

Everything checked by hand

I proofread, test on a phone and put it online myself.

A price on display

From €500, the same for everyone, with no quote to wait for.

Nothing sacrificed

Quality, security, SEO and a real person to talk to are all still there.

What you really pay for in a website

A website is mostly time. When a freelancer builds it entirely by hand, they spend days on it, sometimes weeks: the mock-up, the layout of each screen, the first drafts of the text, the settings, the tests. That time has a price, and it is what makes up the bill.

According to public benchmarks gathered in France, a showcase website made by a freelancer usually costs between €1,500 and €3,000. Looking after it often costs between €60 and €200 a month. These prices are not inflated: they reflect the work involved.

My idea is different. I spend less time on what repeats from one website to the next, so that small businesses and associations can also have a professional website, at a price they can afford.

No magic: just optimisation

I have spent time automating my work, and I have direct access to French hosting providers. That is what lets me offer these prices. It is not magic, it is optimisation.

Automated work where things repeat

Many steps come back on every project. For those, I have help from Lia, my autonomous assistant: she automates the repetitive tasks. What used to take me days now takes a few hours, and both the lead time and the price come down accordingly.

  • The basic layout: a first version of the screens, based on what you told me.
  • First drafts of the text: a starting point, which I then rework with your own words.
  • Settings: the titles read by Google, how the website looks on phones, the contact form.

The result: a one-page website is ready in 3 to 5 days, a showcase website in 1 to 2 weeks.

Direct hosting

Your websites are hosted in France, with hosting providers I deal with directly. There is no middleman between them and me, and that is also what keeps the subscription at a low price.

What I do by hand

Lia is fast, but she decides nothing. I am the one who designs your website: I listen to you, make the choices and go over everything she prepares.

  • Proofreading: every page, every text, every opening time and every price shown.
  • Phone testing: I go through the website on several devices, just as your customers will.
  • Checking: the links, the form, the loading speed, the information meant for Google.
  • Going live: I connect your domain name, install the padlock that protects your visitors and publish the website myself.

Your website only goes live after it has been through my hands.

A price on display, no quote needed

With many providers, you have to ask for a quote, wait, then compare. Here, the price is written on the website and it is the same for everyone. Creation starts at €500, for a one-page website as well as for a showcase website of up to five pages. An online shop adds €200.

You pay 25% when you order and the rest when the website goes live, in one go or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments. After that, the €10 a month subscription keeps the website running, with no commitment. The full details are on the Prices page.

Market prices, honestly

Compared with a showcase website made by a freelancer, the gap is often 4 to 5 times. Still, I prefer to give you the full picture: some budget offers also exist, from €400 to €1,300 for a website. Compared with those, we are in the same range.

The difference then lies in what comes with it: checking by hand, follow-up after the launch, and someone who answers when you have a question.

These ranges are rough guides, taken from public pages in November 2026. Each provider sets their own prices, and a particular project may cost more or less.

What is not sacrificed

A lower price does not mean rushed work. Here is what you keep, whichever website you choose:

  • Quality: a modern, clear and fast website, designed for phones first.
  • Security: the HTTPS padlock, updates done for you, backups and a monitored website.
  • SEO: the basics are in place on every page, so that Google understands your business.
  • A real person to talk to: when you write, I am the one who reads and replies, within 72 hours.
  • Your freedom: the domain name is in your name, and the subscription stops whenever you decide.

And if your project goes beyond what I do well, like a custom-built app or a catalogue of thousands of products, I will tell you from our very first conversation.

Your questions

Does cheaper mean worse?

No. The price is lower because I spend less time on what repeats, not because I skip steps. Every website is proofread, tested on a phone and checked before it goes live.

Does Lia build my website on her own?

No. I am the one who designs your website. Lia automates the repetitive tasks: a basic layout, first drafts of the text, settings. I then go over everything by hand, make the choices with you and publish the website myself.

Are there any costs on top of the price shown?

No. Creation starts at €500, then the subscription costs €10 a month. The options are not compulsory, and their price is shown before you order.

Why is there no quote?

Because most websites for the self-employed, tradespeople, shops or associations are built in the same way. A fixed price is simpler for you and for me. For an unusual project, I will tell you so honestly.
